figure_description: A Cartesian coordinate plane with horizontal x-axis and vertical y-axis intersecting at origin 0. A smooth curve labeled y = f(x) passes from below the negative x-axis, crosses below the origin, and continues into the fourth quadrant, then curves upward to cross the positive x-axis between values a and b, entering the first quadrant and continuing to increase. A vertical line segment extends downward from x = a on the positive x-axis to the curve, bounding a shaded region labeled S_1 below the x-axis and above the curve. A vertical line segment extends upward from x = b on the positive x-axis to the curve, bounding a shaded region labeled S_2 above the x-axis and below the curve.
